task.name: open_microwave_door_put_bowl
task.description: Use the left arm to open the microwave oven door. Then use the right arm to put the blue bowl inside the microwave oven.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the microwave oven door handle.
2. Grasp the microwave oven door handle with the left arm.
3. Pull the microwave oven door open using the left arm.
4. Move the right arm to approach and align with the blue bowl.
5. Grasp the blue bowl with the right arm.
6. Move the right arm to align with the inside of the microwave oven.
7. Release the gripper to place the blue bowl inside the microwave oven.
